professionalSummary: Three‑year experience coordinating signalling renewals for a contractor, managing possession plans, schedules, briefings, permits, progress reporting, delivery tracking and commissioning hand‑over notes across three sites.
experienceHighlights: Maintained weekly possession plans and works schedules in sync with contractor progress for three renewal sites.
Recorded possession briefings and site access permits per programme procedures, audited with zero findings by the infrastructure owner.
Prepared and delivered weekly progress reports to the infrastructure owner’s representative, incorporating their comments.
Tracked equipment deliveries against the schedule, resolving supplier queries and flagging items requiring project manager possession decisions.
Authored commissioning stage hand‑over notes, countersigned by the commissioning engineer for each site.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report and a commissioning stage hand‑over note, with programme folder references as a verification trail.

evidence.text: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

Reference call with the former renewals project manager: confirmed the candidate kept the plans and the records in the period, with possession decisions and commissioning sign-off remaining with the manager and the commissioning engineer, and confirmed the dates.

The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.

Reference call with the former renewals project manager: confirmed the candidate kept the plans and the records in the period, with possession decisions and commissioning sign-off remaining with the manager and the commissioning engineer, and confirmed the dates.
The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

Work sample: a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report and a commissioning stage hand-over note, with programme folder references as a verification trail.

Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.

Reference call with the former renewals project manager: confirmed the candidate kept the plans and the records in the period, with possession decisions and commissioning sign-off remaining with the manager and the commissioning engineer, and confirmed the dates.
Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.

Work sample: a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report and a commissioning stage hand-over note, with programme folder references as a verification trail.
